title: Tuning-dependent targeted perturbation responses
disposition_reason: The inactive ALM source has a complete prospective response estimator, conditional-effect analysis, held-mouse response scorer and a separate numerical-reproduction grader. A valid reproduction only establishes agreement with that declared analysis. Genuine mappings/provider, authentic execution and a frozen aggregate held-mouse comparator evaluation remain to be qualified.

scientific_target.question: Does independently measured target/follower tuning add held-mouse predictive information about stimulation-associated calcium responses beyond distance, baseline activity, movement, power and site class, and what mouse-level conditional associations remain under the complete overlapping stimulation design?
scientific_target.known_answer: For prediction, the held mouse response is an operator-estimated calcium-response coefficient from the declared full-schedule lag model. For investigation, numerical effects/controls are independently recomputed from the same frozen observations and estimator; their sign is not a known biological answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source calcium signals, complete stimulus timing/power/condition schedule, independent prestimulation baseline and cross-epoch cell identities. The response label is a benchmark-defined model-derived estimand, not an independently recorded synaptic weight.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held mouse with all eligible target×power×condition×follower responses; a separate complete mouse-level investigation report retains all controls and exclusions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; cells, target/follower pairs, sessions, frames and overlapping pulses are nested dependent observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional association and prediction under a specified calcium-response model. Response-defined responding/nonresponding sites are observational classes; random switching of targets does not randomize those classes. Contact-aligned[0,1) tuning includes postcontact/reward activity.
exclusions: No treating exact reproduction of an analysis table as direct interpretation or independent scientific discovery.

inputs: Investigation uses the complete stimulation schedule, source calcium/ROI identity, artifact and processing-support masks, independently measured movement, distance/power/site context and independent prestimulation baseline.
Tuning is computed on allowed regular-reward behavior blocks with all native directions and explicit behavior/rest/baseline cell links; fixed contact[0,1)seconds is a prospective choice.
Held-mouse response packets expose train-mouse response labels plus query target/follower tuning and nuisance features, restricted to independently pretest-classified sites.
forbidden_inputs: Held-mouse stimulation response signals/labels in the held-response prediction arm.
Response-derived held-mouse site labels, response-based cell matching, tuning fit on held behavior blocks, or baseline computed from stimulation responses.
Artificially isolated pulses ignoring192ms switching overlap, unknown movement replaced by zero, or nonresponding sites substituted for true sham.
observation_contract.case_identity: Public case IDs are HMAC(response,held_mouse); response identities bind mouse,session,epoch,target_id,power,condition and follower ROI. The numerical report binds source and disposition digests. No authentic emitted roster has been produced.
observation_contract.split: Implemented leave-one-mouse-out response prediction keeps all held-mouse responses private and accepts independently pretest-classified sites only. Tuning uses explicitly allowed versus held behavior blocks. Matching cutoffs/calipers come from other mice. Investigation reconstruction is a separate observed-data channel, not the prediction split.
observation_contract.coverage: Required source ascertainment spans61 imaging/behavior sessions in15 mice and the52-stimulation-session/13-mouse subset. Full target×power×condition×ten100ms-lag design is retained; no subsampling when design exceeds capacity. Eligible pair counts and mouse support remain unverified.

primary.name: Held-mouse response MSE improvement over fixed nuisance-only ridge
primary.aggregation: Proposed primary comparison: per-mouse nuisance-only MSE minus candidate MSE, averaged equally across eligible held mice; retain all unsupported mice as explicit dispositions. Existing code emits candidate MSE and reference nuisance-versus-tuning improvement separately, so this paired aggregate must be bound before an empirical claim.
primary.rationale: Requires prediction of withheld neural responses beyond measured nuisance structure. Numerical reproduction is a correctness prerequisite and cannot substitute for this outcome.

secondary: Per-mouse candidate MSE and fixed tuning-reference MSE; report response units and model-derived label provenance.
Per-mouse adjusted/unadjusted tuning-response effects and crossfit matched high/low contrasts with uncertainty.
Independent numerical reproduction maximum error for effects, improvement and complete controls; interpretation sign is unscored.
Design rank/condition number, distance strata, optical-proximity exclusions, unmatched-pair dispositions and true-sham availability.

comparators.name: Nuisance-only held-mouse ridge
comparators.inputs: Distance and squared distance, independent baseline, measured movement, power and independently pretest site class
comparators.procedure: Implemented StandardScaler plus ridge alpha=1, fit on other mice; each training mouse total weight one.

comparators.name: Tuning-plus-nuisance held-mouse ridge
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance features plus tuning similarity and site-class interaction
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed alpha=1 paired reference on identical train/test mice; gain does not establish causal tuning influence.

comparators.name: Full-schedule response estimator and null diagnostics
comparators.inputs: Complete overlapping target×power×condition schedule, calcium, artifact/support masks and movement
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed ridge alpha=1, ten100ms lag bins through1s, exposure-integrated design; lead schedule and within-distance tuning rotations are diagnostics, not randomization p-values.

nuisance_controls: Retain full overlapping stimulation schedule and report rank/conditioning; regularization does not establish individual causal identifiability.
Remove direct/optically proximal targets below25µm; report[25,50),[50,100),[100,250] and>250µm strata.
Use separate prestimulation baseline with authenticated cross-epoch cell links; keep missing identities and unsupported comparisons visible.
Fit matching quartiles and0.2SD calipers on other mice; exact equality required for zero spread, tied quartiles are non-estimable.
Separate response-selected-site sensitivity from predictive sites classified independently before testing; absence of true sham stays absent.
evaluation.uncertainty: Mouse-level paired response-improvement uncertainty and conditional-effect intervals; current source has approximate mouse t intervals for effects, not a qualified full predictive comparison. Do not use pair/frame counts as replication, and retain uncertainty from model-derived response labels as an unresolved limitation.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exact response IDs, full finite response vectors, source/disposition digests and complete control-family reporting. Reject fabricated values for non-estimable mice. Preserve null/inconclusive results and unsupported matches; report missing actors/cases rather than dropping them.

implementation.scorer_target: score_responses compares submitted responses to private benchmark-estimated response coefficients using MSE. grade_investigation checks effects/improvements/control results against operator recomputation and explicitly does not score interpretation. Internal source does not yet bind a candidate-versus-nuisance aggregate primary outcome.
implementation.delivered_scope: Prospective complete scientific calculation/packet/scorer source is present, but central entry is status-only and the actual native mapping/provider is missing. Recomputed coefficients are legitimate declared estimands, not direct measurements of synaptic connectivity.
missing: Authenticated source schedule, ROI/cell/clock mapping, artifact/movement/baseline producers and full eligible mouse/pair census.

summary: Separated withheld response prediction from numerical investigation reconstruction and made their distinct answer origins explicit.
Specified nuisance-matched held-mouse response improvement as the primary scientific comparison, recording the missing candidate-comparator aggregation.
Retained full overlapping design, independent baseline/pretest site restriction and mouse-level controls; rejected causal and visual-shortcut overclaims.
Identified the missing public investigation observation packet required by the operator extra investigation submission.
Separated preparation/reference/scoring source from participant access: frozen programme and adaptive tool execution are not delivered.
